requirements.summary: Every liveness-scoped ancestor link is evaluated at presentation and an unevaluatable link denies fail closed.
Delegation implicitly conjoins the Origin.Derived ceiling as an ordinary Constraint.
Base authorization is evaluated once before an effect begins and is not implicitly re-evaluated mid-effect.
The target evaluates the full derivation-chain Constraint conjunction rather than the leaf alone.
Quantified Constraints pool at their chain occurrence, denied executions consume nothing, and unenforceable declared scope denies.
Delegability is default-on and narrowed only by a conjoining Constraint, never by a separately granted Boolean right.
Authority and selection use structural strong-Kleene evaluation rather than whole-expression poisoning.
Constraint values are never additively projected across Shape versions; ordinary payload compatibility is unchanged.
Constraint declarations name identity, value Shape/version, evaluator domain, unknown behavior, accounting scope when relevant, evolution policy, and the recognition set.
A provider issues resource authority by Delegation from its primordial resource-space authority and cannot exceed that chain.
Each domain records its chain-conjunction representation and the resulting revocation ceiling as an operational property.
Dynamic-Actor domains declare Terminus disposition for held authority, outbound grants, survival schedules, and stable references.
Base legibility is limited to explicit first hops; transitive authority topology remains an extension direction.
Held-authority introspection remains an explicit open architecture decision, separate from operation discovery.
